title: Python: Import and clean the marriage data

cues.en: Mike: This and the next several videos is exclusively in Python.
cues.zh: Mike：這部與接下來幾部影片，都只使用 Python。

cues.en: Okay, so first, of course, we import all of the libraries that we're going to need.
cues.zh: 首先，當然要匯入所有需要的函式庫。

cues.en: Standard ones like NumPy, Matplotlib, we're also going to do some statistics, in particular T-tests and correlations.
cues.zh: 像 NumPy、Matplotlib 這些常用函式庫；我們也要做統計，尤其是 t 檢定與相關。

cues.en: And I'm also going to run a principle components analysis on the data, and we're going to use Pandas to import the data and also to store some of the features of the data.
cues.zh: 我也會對資料執行主成分分析，並用 Pandas 匯入資料，以及儲存資料的某些特徵。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have the direct URLs to the data sets.
cues.zh: 這裡是資料集的直接網址。

cues.en: So the data sets are Excel files, that are just directly posted on the CDC website.
cues.zh: 資料集是直接放在 CDC 網站上的 Excel 檔案。

cues.en: So we have the URL for the marriage Excel file, and for the divorce Excel file.
cues.zh: 這是結婚資料 Excel 檔的網址，以及離婚資料 Excel 檔的網址。

cues.en: Okay, so let me import these libraries here.
cues.zh: 先匯入這些函式庫。

cues.en: Run this code here.
cues.zh: 執行這裡的程式。

cues.en: And now we're going to import the marriage data.
cues.zh: 現在要匯入結婚資料。

cues.en: Now, you know, just importing the data is really simple, it's just one line of code.
cues.zh: 單純匯入資料非常簡單，只需要一行程式。

cues.en: But, you'll see that importing, you know, this also involves some cleaning, some processing, some visualization, so there's actually quite a bit that we need to do,
cues.zh: 但你會看到，匯入也涉及清理、處理與視覺化，所以在開始使用這些資料之前，

cues.en: before we can start working with these data.
cues.zh: 其實還有不少事情要做。

cues.en: So I use this, Pandas function read Excel, and we just input the marriage U, so yeah the URL directly.
cues.zh: 我使用 Pandas 的 read_excel 函式，直接輸入 marriageU，也就是網址。

cues.en: Of course, if you have the file locally, you could also just replace this with the location of the file on your hard drive.
cues.zh: 當然，如果本機已有檔案，也可以把這裡替換成硬碟上的檔案位置。

cues.en: And then, so we import the data, and let's have a look at that data frame.
cues.zh: 匯入資料後，看看這個 DataFrame。

cues.en: So here we see that the rows correspond to the states, so yeah, all the different states.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，每一列對應各州，也就是所有不同的州。

cues.en: And then we have the columns corresponding to years, so here's 2019, 2018, and so on.
cues.zh: 欄則對應年份，這裡是 2019、2018 等等。

cues.en: This is actually not the entire data set here.
cues.zh: 這裡其實沒有顯示完整資料集。

cues.en: And then you see, you know, there's some other rows here that are, that are useless, this is not a row that contains any real data.
cues.zh: 你也會看到，這裡有些列沒有用，不包含任何真正的資料。

cues.en: This is a row of NaNs, row zero.
cues.zh: 這是全為 NaN 的一列，也就是第 0 列。

cues.en: And then when we go all the way down here to the bottom, and we see, that there's more rows without any data.
cues.zh: 再一路往下到底部，可以看到還有更多沒有資料的列。

cues.en: So, based on looking at this, and also based on having looked at the Excel spreadsheet, I'm going to remove the irrelevant rows, so these are the rows that I am going to drop.
cues.zh: 根據這裡看到的，以及先前看過的 Excel 試算表，我要移除不相關的列，這些就是要刪除的列。

cues.en: And I figured out these indices manually just by looking at them, so we see, you know, 54 and 55, these are not rows of the data file
cues.zh: 這些索引是我直接看資料，手動找出來的；例如 54 與 55，這些列並不包含

cues.en: that contain any data that we want.
cues.zh: 我們想要的資料。

cues.en: And the axis zero tells Python that we want to remove the rows, as opposed to, you know, if we did it like this, we would be removing columns.
cues.zh: axis=0 告訴 Python，我們想移除列；相對地，如果這樣寫，就會移除欄。

cues.en: And in place just means that it's removing it directly from the data, so we don't have to say data equals data dot drop, so it just directly removes the data.
cues.zh: inplace 表示直接從資料中移除，所以不必寫 data 等於 data.drop，而是直接移除資料。

cues.en: Okay, so now, we run that and look at the data again, and then we see, you know, that top row was eliminated, and the bottom row was eliminated as well.
cues.zh: 執行後，再看一次資料，會看到最上面與最下面的列都刪除了。

cues.en: And now we see that our data contains 51 rows and 24 columns, and 51 makes sense, because we have 50 states plus the District of Columbia,
cues.zh: 現在資料包含 51 列與 24 欄；51 很合理，因為有 50 州加上哥倫比亞特區，

cues.en: Washington DC, which is not this Washington, that's the Washington state.
cues.zh: 也就是華盛頓特區，並不是這裡這個 Washington，這是華盛頓州。

cues.en: We have, it's listed under D for District of Columbia.
cues.zh: 特區列在 D，也就是 District of Columbia 下面。

cues.en: Okay, so looking through, here, oh wait, there's one more thing I wanted to mention, because, we are dropping these rows in place, that means that we've overwritten the data variable,
cues.zh: 看看這裡，等一下，還有一件事要說：因為我們直接原地刪除這些列，所以已經覆寫 data 變數，

cues.en: so if you would try to run this line again, then Python is going to try to remove, again, rows zero and 52 through 57.
cues.zh: 如果再執行這一行，Python 就會再次嘗試移除第 0 列以及第 52 到 57 列。

cues.en: So in fact, because those rows now don't exist, we get an error message.
cues.zh: 但這些列已經不存在，因此會出現錯誤訊息。

cues.en: But, you know, this is potentially dangerous because if you would just say, you know, remove row zero and five.
cues.zh: 不過，這有潛在危險，因為如果你說要移除第 0 列與第 5 列，

cues.en: Right, zero is also removed, let's say remove rows two and five.
cues.zh: 對，0 也已經移除了，那就改成移除第 2 列與第 5 列。

cues.en: So now what I've done is actually just remove states from here, so this is something to be mindful of.
cues.zh: 現在我其實從這裡移除了州，所以要留意這一點。

cues.en: When you are running operations in place, you are losing the original data, so in fact, we have, you know, totally screwed up these data, so let me undo undo,
cues.zh: 執行原地操作時，會失去原始資料；事實上，我們已經把資料弄亂了，所以先復原、復原，

cues.en: and now I'm going to reimport the data from scratch from the website.
cues.zh: 現在從網站重新匯入原始資料。

cues.en: Okay, so now we get the original data, with the extraneous rows that I'm going to drop, again.
cues.zh: 這樣就取得原始資料，包括那些多餘的列，再刪除一次。

cues.en: And we can confirm that we still have 51 rows and 24 columns, so 24 columns corresponds to the years,
cues.zh: 可以確認仍然有 51 列與 24 欄；24 欄對應年份，

cues.en: plus the one extra column for the listing of the states.
cues.zh: 再加上一欄州名。

cues.en: Okay, so looking through this data, we can see that there's some missing data entries here.
cues.zh: 查看資料，可以看到這裡有一些遺失項目。

cues.en: Here's a missing data entry, it's three dashes.
cues.zh: 這裡就是一個遺失項目，用三個破折號表示。

cues.en: There's no data there, here we see two other cases where there's missing data.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有資料，另外這兩處也有資料遺失。

cues.en: So we need to do something with those missing data.
cues.zh: 因此，必須處理這些遺失資料。

cues.en: Now, I discussed in a previous section that you have many options for how to deal with missing data.
cues.zh: 先前章節討論過，處理遺失資料有很多選擇。

cues.en: What I am going to do, is replace those with the column median.
cues.zh: 我要用欄中位數來替換它們。

cues.en: Now, let me get to that in a moment, the first thing I wanna do is replace all of the triple dashes with NaNs.
cues.zh: 稍後再談這個；首先，把所有三個破折號替換成 NaN。

cues.en: So when I run this cell of code, that converts all of the dash dash dash cells into NaN cells, so NaN, of course, stands for not a number.
cues.zh: 執行這個程式區塊，所有三個破折號的儲存格就會轉成 NaN；NaN 當然代表非數值。

cues.en: So what I have decided to do to interpolate over those NaN values, is to replace all of the NaN values, all the cells that contain NaN,
cues.zh: 我決定對這些 NaN 做插補，方式是把所有 NaN 值、所有包含 NaN 的儲存格，

cues.en: with the median of the data column.
cues.zh: 替換成資料所在欄的中位數。

cues.en: So that means that, let's see, where do we have our first NaN?
cues.zh: 也就是說，第一個 NaN 在哪裡？

cues.en: So this value here is going to be replaced with the median of all the other values from all the other states, so all the marriage rates,
cues.zh: 這裡這個值會替換成其他所有州的所有其他值的中位數，也就是所有結婚率，

cues.en: across all the other states from this particular year.
cues.zh: 在這個特定年份中，其他所有州的結婚率中位數。

cues.en: Now why did I make that decision?
cues.zh: 為什麼做這個決定？

cues.en: Well, you know, it's just based on an assumption that I made, and that assumption is that all of the states are going to have roughly similar marriage rates each year.
cues.zh: 這只是基於我做的一個假設，也就是各州每年的結婚率大致相似。

cues.en: And I chose to use the median instead of the mean, just in case there are some outliers, I don't want the replacement to be biased by any potential outliers in the data.
cues.zh: 我選擇中位數而不是平均值，是為了避免可能的離群值，不希望替換值受到資料中潛在離群值的偏移。

cues.en: Now, these are just assumptions, I cannot tell you that replacing NaNs with the column median is absolutely the correct or the only right way to do this,
cues.zh: 這些只是一些假設，我不能說用欄中位數替換 NaN，絕對是正確或唯一正確的方式，

cues.en: we could have also replaced it with the row median, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，也可以用列中位數替換。

cues.en: We could have done some other fancy interpolation, like set each NaN value to be the average of the previous value, and the subsequent value.
cues.zh: 也可以做其他更複雜的插補，例如把每個 NaN 設成前一個值與後一個值的平均。

cues.en: But this is the option that I chose here.
cues.zh: 但這裡我選擇這個方式。

cues.en: Okay, so, we replace all the NaNs in place, again, so we're overriding the data matrix.
cues.zh: 同樣地，我們原地替換所有 NaN，因此會覆寫資料矩陣。

cues.en: And now you can see we're scrolling down., again, you know, this is not the entire data set that we're looking at here, but, you can see that there are no longer any NaNs to be seen.
cues.zh: 現在往下捲；這裡仍然沒有顯示完整資料集，但可以看到，已經沒有 NaN。

cues.en: Okay, so now we've imported the data, we've done some processing of the data.
cues.zh: 現在已經匯入資料，也做了一些處理。

cues.en: What I want to do is extract some of the data from Pandas data frame into a NumPy matrix.
cues.zh: 接下來，我想把 Pandas DataFrame 中的一些資料，擷取成 NumPy 矩陣。

cues.en: Now, there's no particular reason why the data need to be in a matrix as opposed to a NumPy array, as opposed to a Pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 資料不一定非得是矩陣或 NumPy 陣列，而不能是 Pandas DataFrame，沒有什麼特別的理由。

cues.en: That's my personal preference, I personally prefer working with NumPy than Pandas.
cues.zh: 這只是我的個人偏好，我比較喜歡使用 NumPy，而不是 Pandas。

cues.en: Again, these are choices that I am making as the, you know, the data investigator here, as the data scientist.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些都是我作為資料研究者、資料科學家所做的選擇。

cues.en: So here I'm extracting the years, the state labels, actually, this is going to remain in Pandas format, this is going to remain as a Pandas series.
cues.zh: 這裡擷取年份與州標籤；這個其實會維持 Pandas 格式，維持為 Pandas Series。

cues.en: And the data matrix itself, so lemme comment these out, so we can see what the years look like, you can see, well, yeah, it's just an array of numbers
cues.zh: 還有資料矩陣本身。先把這些註解掉，就能看看年份的樣子；就是一個數值陣列，

cues.en: corresponding to the years.
cues.zh: 對應各個年份。

cues.en: And, then we have the states, and this is still a Pandas series.
cues.zh: 接著是州名，仍然是 Pandas Series。

cues.en: So we have the numbers here, the row numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡是數字，也就是列號。

cues.en: And the the labels, which are the names of all the states.
cues.zh: 還有標籤，也就是所有州的名稱。

cues.en: Okay, and then we have the data matrix, and I'm calling that M for marriage.
cues.zh: 接著是資料矩陣，我把它命名為 M，代表 marriage。

cues.en: The next video, we're gonna import the divorce rate data, and I'm gonna call that matrix D.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會匯入離婚率資料，並把矩陣命名為 D。

cues.en: Okay, so here you see all of the data.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到所有資料。

cues.en: And let's see, sometimes, you know, when you're displaying these matrices, it's convenient to round them to two or three significant digits
cues.zh: 有時顯示矩陣時，把數字四捨五入到兩、三個有效數字會比較方便，

cues.en: after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 也就是小數點後的位數。

cues.en: That just curtails the numbers a little bit to make it easier to visualize, so here we see the first row, the second row, and so on.
cues.zh: 這能稍微縮短數字，方便查看；這裡是第一列、第二列，依此類推。

cues.en: Okay, so at this point, we have imported the data from the web, we've done some cleaning and some processing.
cues.zh: 到這裡，已經從網路匯入資料，做了一些清理與處理。

cues.en: And now I wanna start visualizing the data, because, you know, it's one thing just to look at these numbers, but, that doesn't really give you a sense of what's going on, we need to make graphs, we need to make plots,
cues.zh: 現在要開始視覺化，因為單看這些數字是一回事，但並不能讓你感受到發生什麼；需要畫圖，

cues.en: to understand, what are the characteristics of the data, what does the data look like, how are they changing over time, and so on.
cues.zh: 才能了解資料有哪些特徵、長什麼樣子、如何隨時間變化等等。

cues.en: So we're gonna make a number of plots here.
cues.zh: 我們會畫好幾張圖。

cues.en: We're going to start with a line plot, so we're gonna plot the marriage rates for each state, over years, and actually maybe I will, let's see, I think I will comment out all of this stuff,
cues.zh: 先從折線圖開始，畫出每個州的結婚率對年份；也許先把這些全部註解掉，

cues.en: just so we can focus on one plot at a time.
cues.zh: 這樣就能一次專注在一張圖。

cues.en: So here we see time on the X axis, marriage rates, again, this is the number of marriages per 1000 people
cues.zh: 這裡 X 軸是時間，結婚率則一樣，是每 1,000 人的結婚件數，

cues.en: in that state.
cues.zh: 在該州內每 1,000 人。

cues.en: And each line here corresponds to a different state.
cues.zh: 這裡每條線都對應一個不同的州。

cues.en: So, you know, it's clearly one huge state that's an outlier, and we'll get back to this in a few moments.
cues.zh: 顯然有一個非常高的州，是個離群值，稍後會再談。

cues.en: But there's something important to notice.
cues.zh: 但有件重要的事要注意。

cues.en: And the rest of these states, it's kind of hard to tell, you know, it looks like they're all roughly flat lines, but that might actually just be because of this one outlier
cues.zh: 其他州有點難判斷，看起來大致是平的，但可能只是因為這個離群值

cues.en: that's skewing the Y axis scaling here.
cues.zh: 影響了這裡 Y 軸的尺度。

cues.en: So therefore, I want to re-plot this, with all of the states having the same numerical range, and the way that I'm going to do that is by Z normalizing,
cues.zh: 因此，我想重畫，讓所有州有相同的數值範圍；我要透過 Z 標準化來做，

cues.en: so you can see, this plot is the same as the one we just looked at, but I'm Z scoring all of the data.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這張圖與剛才一樣，但我把所有資料轉成 Z 分數。

cues.en: So let's run this line.
cues.zh: 執行這一行。

cues.en: Now we see, again, each line corresponds to a different state.
cues.zh: 現在一樣，每條線代表一個不同的州。

cues.en: And now we don't see any outliers because we've said normalize.
cues.zh: 現在看不到離群值，因為已經做了 Z 標準化。

cues.en: But, this nicely shows that all of the states are generally declining, so it looks like the marriage rates are decreasing over time,
cues.zh: 但這很好地顯示，各州整體都在下降，所以結婚率似乎隨時間減少，

cues.en: over this roughly 30-year period here.
cues.zh: 在這裡約 30 年的期間內。

cues.en: Okay, so there's one more line plot that I wanted to make down here.
cues.zh: 下面還有一張我想做的折線圖。

cues.en: And that is the plot of the averages across all of the states.
cues.zh: 也就是所有州平均值的圖。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is taking the marriage data, and I am averaging, and I'm averaging over axis equals zero, which means I'm averaging over all the rows,
cues.zh: 這裡取結婚資料的平均，沿 axis=0，也就是對所有列取平均，

cues.en: which means I'm averaging over all of these states.
cues.zh: 也就是對所有這些州取平均。

cues.en: And I'm also putting a marker, a little square at each data point, so that we can see that the X axis is actually non-constant.
cues.zh: 我也在每個資料點加一個小方形標記，讓我們看出 X 軸的間隔其實並不固定。

cues.en: Okay, so let's run this cell of code again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次這個程式區塊。

cues.en: Now we see, so this is one line, corresponding to the average over all of the states.
cues.zh: 現在看到一條線，對應所有州的平均。

cues.en: And again, you know, now you really see that we don't have data at every single year, so we have data at 1990, 1995, then starting in '99,
cues.zh: 同樣地，現在可以很清楚看到，並不是每年都有資料；有 1990、1995，接著從 1999 年開始，

cues.en: we begin to have data each year.
cues.zh: 才每年都有資料。

cues.en: So this also shows you that there is, you know, a national trend of decreasing marriage rates over this 30-year period.
cues.zh: 這也顯示，在這 30 年中，全國結婚率有下降趨勢。

cues.en: Now, I would like to, to think about a question, I would like you to think about a question here.
cues.zh: 現在我想思考一個問題，也希望你想想這個問題。

cues.en: The question is, is this line, so the average over all these states, is that the same thing as the national average of marriage rates over time?
cues.zh: 這條線，也就是所有州的平均，是否等於全國結婚率隨時間的平均？

cues.en: So the average of all the states, is that the same thing as the national average, so the national, the average of the entire US population over time.
cues.zh: 所有州的平均，是否等於全國平均，也就是整個美國人口隨時間的平均？

cues.en: If you would like some time to think about that question, feel free to pause video.
cues.zh: 如果想花點時間思考，可以暫停影片。

cues.en: So the answer is yes, this line would be equal to the national average.
cues.zh: 答案是會，這條線會等於全國平均。

cues.en: Now you might initially think that the answer would be no.
cues.zh: 一開始，你可能認為答案是不會。

cues.en: Because here, each line in this dataset, so each row in our dataset, corresponds to a different state, and different states have wildly different populations,
cues.zh: 因為這個資料集的每一條線、每一列，都對應不同的州，而各州人口數差異非常大，

cues.en: you know?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: You can compare California, which has tens of millions of people, versus Hawaii, which, I don't know what the population of Hawaii is, but I guess it's much, much, much smaller
cues.zh: 可以比較有數千萬人口的加州與夏威夷；我不知道夏威夷人口多少，但我猜遠遠小於

cues.en: than the population of California.
cues.zh: 加州的人口。

cues.en: So that would make you think that, you know, we're sort of unfairly averaging together states with vastly different population sizes.
cues.zh: 因此，你可能認為，把人口規模差距很大的州直接平均，有點不公平。

cues.en: However, in this dataset, the marriage rates are all normalized to the rates per 1000 people.
cues.zh: 不過，這個資料集的結婚率，都已正規化成每 1,000 人的比率。

cues.en: So because the data are normalized within each state, then averaging the data from all the states together is actually equivalent to the national average.
cues.zh: 因為各州內的資料都經過正規化，所以把所有州的資料取平均，其實等於全國平均。

cues.en: Now, if these data were not normalized,
cues.zh: 如果這些資料沒有正規化，

cues.en: if it weren't normalized to marriage rates per 1000 people, and we just had the raw number of marriages in each state, each year, then that would be a different story, than we would be taking a weighted average year.
cues.zh: 沒有轉成每 1,000 人的結婚率，而是只有各州每年的原始結婚數，那就不同了；那時要取加權平均。

cues.en: Okay, so I think now we have a pretty good sense of what's going on with these data based on these lines.
cues.zh: 現在根據這些線，我們已經很清楚資料的大致情況。

cues.en: The last graph that I wanted to show was an image of the marriage rates over time, that's color coordinated, so, we see that each row in this data matrix
cues.zh: 最後想展示的圖，是結婚率隨時間的彩色影像；這個資料矩陣的每一列，

cues.en: corresponds to the state, and the X axis here corresponds to the year.
cues.zh: 對應一個州，而 X 軸對應年份。

cues.en: And these this is the Z normalized, lemme scroll up here, so this is the, we're making an image of the Z-scored data matrix.
cues.zh: 這些是 Z 標準化資料；往上捲一下，這裡是把 Z 分數資料矩陣畫成影像。

cues.en: So that's why we see negative and positive values here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會看到負值與正值。

cues.en: Now it might initially look a little strange that we go from blue, so from negative numbers to positive numbers here.
cues.zh: 一開始可能覺得有點奇怪，這裡是從藍色、從負數變成正數，

cues.en: because that seems to be the opposite, here we are declining.
cues.zh: 看起來方向相反，因為這裡是在下降。

cues.en: However, in the actual data matrix, let me scroll back up to the data matrix from the Pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 但在實際資料矩陣中，讓我往上捲回 Pandas DataFrame 的資料矩陣。

cues.en: We see that actually the first column in the data matrix is the year 2019.
cues.zh: 可以看到，資料矩陣的第一欄其實是 2019 年。

cues.en: So in fact, we are going backwards in time.
cues.zh: 所以時間其實是倒著走。

cues.en: Now when we plot this using line plots, Python is going to re-sort this, so we have the smaller numbers to the left, and the larger numbers to the right.
cues.zh: 用折線圖畫的時候，Python 會重新排序，讓較小的數在左邊，較大的數在右邊。

cues.en: But when we make an image, you know, the imshow function doesn't know or care about the ordering of these years, so imshow shows the image
cues.zh: 但畫影像時，imshow 函式不知道、也不在乎年份順序，它顯示影像時，

cues.en: in the order in which it is directly presented in the matrix.
cues.zh: 直接按照矩陣中給定的順序。

cues.en: So it's a tricky thing to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 這是需要留意的細節。

cues.en: But otherwise, this matrix is showing us the same data as all of these lines here just spread out and colorized.
cues.zh: 除此之外，這個矩陣呈現的資料，與這些線相同，只是分開並以顏色表示。

cues.en: Okay, very nice, so, I wanna do some more data visualizations, I wanna show a bar plot of the average marriage rate within each state.
cues.zh: 很好，接著想做更多資料視覺化，展示各州平均結婚率的長條圖。

cues.en: So, here we are averaging over the marriage data matrix, but now I'm averaging over the columns, which corresponds to the years.
cues.zh: 這裡一樣對結婚資料矩陣取平均，但這次對欄，也就是年份取平均。

cues.en: Remember up here, I was averaging over.
cues.zh: 記得，上面是沿著……

cues.en: Zero, axis zero, that's here.
cues.zh: 零，axis=0，也就是這裡。

cues.en: So here we were averaging over states, and now I want to average over years within each state, so this result, this output of the mean function
cues.zh: 這裡是對州取平均，現在則想在各州內對年份取平均，因此 mean 函式的結果，

cues.en: is going to give me one value per state, plus Washington DC.
cues.zh: 會給每個州一個值，另外還有華盛頓特區。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm sorting them, so that we are going to view this bar plot sorted.
cues.zh: 接著排序，讓長條圖按照排序結果顯示。

cues.en: Okay, so there we see all of the average marriage rates across a 30-year period, per 1000 people.
cues.zh: 這裡就看到各州在 30 年間，每 1,000 人的平均結婚率，

cues.en: For all the states sorted according to their size.
cues.zh: 並依照數值大小排序。

cues.en: And, we see, you know, most of these states have marriage rates in pretty much the same range, but then, we have this huge outlier here, with Nevada.
cues.zh: 可以看到，大多數州的結婚率大致在相同範圍內，但內華達州是個非常大的離群值。

cues.en: So lots and lots of people are getting married in Nevada, and this actually corresponds to that line, apologies for, you know, scrolling up and down a lot,
cues.zh: 內華達州有非常多人結婚，這其實對應那條線；抱歉，畫面一直上下捲動，

cues.en: but, this line up here, from the marriage rates over time, this corresponds to Nevada.
cues.zh: 就是上面結婚率隨時間變化的這條線，對應內華達州。

cues.en: Now, here's an important question, is this a non-representative but real data point, or, is this an error, is this a mistake?
cues.zh: 這裡有個重要問題：這是不具代表性但真實的資料點，還是錯誤？

cues.en: Maybe, you know, someone was entering the data and their finger slipped when they were typing on the keypad.
cues.zh: 也許有人輸入資料，在數字鍵盤上打字時手滑了。

cues.en: So this could have been a mistake.
cues.zh: 所以這可能是個錯誤。

cues.en: Well, to find out, I did a bit of Google searching, and I looked at several different websites, three or four different websites, where I was searching for marriage rates of Nevada,
cues.zh: 為了查明，我用 Google 搜尋了一下，查看三、四個不同網站，搜尋內華達州結婚率，

cues.en: and the state with the highest marriage rates in the US.
cues.zh: 以及美國結婚率最高的州。

cues.en: And multiple websites confirmed that this is a real data point.
cues.zh: 多個網站都確認，這是真實的資料點。

cues.en: It is unusual, it's non-representative.
cues.zh: 它不尋常，也不具代表性。

cues.en: But we don't have any reason to exclude it, because it seems to be valid data, it's just a little bit different from all the other states.
cues.zh: 但沒有理由排除它，因為它看起來是有效資料，只是與其他州有點不同。

cues.en: Now why is the marriage rate so much higher in Nevada, I don't know, maybe it's because of Las Vegas, you know, people like to go to Vegas and get married.
cues.zh: 為什麼內華達州結婚率高這麼多？我不知道，也許是因為拉斯維加斯，大家喜歡去那裡結婚。

cues.en: But anyway, the more important point that I wanted to make here is the importance of data visualization in multiple ways, so we can start investigating the data,
cues.zh: 總之，我更想強調的是，用多種方式做資料視覺化很重要，讓我們開始調查資料，

cues.en: we can see patterns in the data, and we can find, we can detect, non-representative or unusual data points.
cues.zh: 看見資料中的模式，也能找到、偵測不具代表性或不尋常的資料點。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'd like to show a correlation matrix, so I am going to create a correlation matrix of the marriage data over time, so what we see here,
cues.zh: 接著想展示相關矩陣；我要建立結婚資料跨時間的相關矩陣，因此這裡看到的，

cues.en: is a matrix of years by years, where each element in this matrix corresponds to the correlation across all the different states,
cues.zh: 是年份乘以年份的矩陣，每個元素對應跨所有不同州計算的相關，

cues.en: in, you know, the year 2000 versus the year 2015.
cues.zh: 例如 2000 年與 2015 年之間。

cues.en: Now, not surprisingly, the diagonal is one, of course, each year corresponds or correlates perfectly with itself.
cues.zh: 不意外，對角線是 1，因為每一年當然都與自己完全相關。

cues.en: And as you go off the diagonal, you'll also see some very high correlations.
cues.zh: 離開對角線，也會看到一些非常高的相關。

cues.en: Now it looks like, as we get further away in time, the correlations are getting weaker.
cues.zh: 不過，看起來隨著時間距離變大，相關越來越弱。

cues.en: So here, the correlation of the marriage rates, over states, in 1990 versus 2019, looks like it's a pretty weak correlation.
cues.zh: 這裡，跨州比較 1990 與 2019 年的結婚率，看起來相關相當弱。

cues.en: However, you know, we, when I un-comment this line, draw it again with a color bar, you can see that actually, you know, even this dark blue color here, which isn't even this,
cues.zh: 但取消這行註解，加上色條再畫一次，就能看到，其實即使是這個深藍色，

cues.en: so this correlation here across a 30-year period, this is a correlation coefficient of probably somewhere around 0.93 maybe, so, everything, you know,
cues.zh: 也就是這裡跨越 30 年的相關，相關係數可能大約在 0.93 左右；因此，這裡所有值

cues.en: is really, really strongly correlated here.
cues.zh: 其實都非常、非常強烈地相關。

cues.en: By the way, one thing I would like to point out here is that imshow, this function, assumes that there is a linear change across the axes.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，我想指出，imshow 這個函式假設座標軸是線性變化。

cues.en: So this is not formally correct, because, this first row here is 1990, the second row is actually 1995, and then we go to 1999,
cues.zh: 所以這在形式上並不正確，因為第一列是 1990 年，第二列其實是 1995 年，接著跳到 1999 年，

cues.en: and then it increases linearly from there.
cues.zh: 之後才線性增加。

cues.en: So this labeling is not entirely accurate, but, that's okay for now, I just wanted to point that out.
cues.zh: 這個標籤並不完全準確，但目前沒關係，只是想提醒你。

cues.en: Okay, so when I see a correlation matrix where, you know, everything is correlating strongly with everything else, that makes me wonder how many patterns are actually present in this data,
cues.zh: 當我看到一個矩陣中，所有東西都與其他東西高度相關，就會好奇資料裡究竟有多少模式，

cues.en: it could be that there's really just, you know, one characteristic, we can describe the whole data set with one data feature.
cues.zh: 也許真的只有一個特徵，用一個資料特徵就能描述整個資料集。

cues.en: And to do that, to explore that possibility, I'm going to run a principle components analysis on the matrix data.
cues.zh: 為了探索這種可能性，我要對矩陣資料做主成分分析。

cues.en: Now, the only reason why I'm doing the PCA here is to explore the scree plot, which is the Eigen values scaled, so it's the explained variance by each component.
cues.zh: 這裡做 PCA 的唯一原因，是想看看陡坡圖，也就是縮放後的特徵值，代表各成分解釋的變異數。

cues.en: So we can see that the first component, this is actually in proportion, I'm gonna multiply it by 100.
cues.zh: 可以看到，第一個成分；這其實是比例，我要把它乘以 100，

cues.en: So it gives us percent.
cues.zh: 轉成百分比。

cues.en: So the first component explains almost all of the variants, In fact, I'm curious to see what exactly the number is, I think it was somewhere around 98%,
cues.zh: 第一個成分幾乎解釋所有變異數；我很好奇確切數字，我記得大約是 98%，

cues.en: or maybe even 99% to the variance.
cues.zh: 甚至可能是 99% 的變異數。

cues.en: So the first component accounts for 98.2% of the variance of the signal.
cues.zh: 第一個成分解釋訊號變異數的 98.2%。

cues.en: So basically, the entire dataset can be captured as one feature, one data feature.
cues.zh: 基本上，整個資料集可以用一個特徵、一個資料特徵來概括。

cues.en: And it's not so surprising, of course, that one data feature is this general decrease over time.
cues.zh: 當然，這不太意外，那個特徵就是整體隨時間下降。

cues.en: Okay, so that is the end of this first video where we imported and processed the marriage data.
cues.zh: 這就是第一部影片的結尾，我們匯入並處理了結婚資料。

cues.en: In the next video, we're going to repeat this process for the divorce data.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，會對離婚資料重做這個流程。

cues.en: And fortunately it will go a little bit faster because we've already discussed a lot of the important points about processing, visualization, and cleaning.
cues.zh: 幸好會快一些，因為處理、視覺化與清理的許多重要觀念，都已經討論過。
